description: Lazada product search for Singapore, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam and Indonesia, from the JSON the Lazada catalog page itself loads: product name, item ID, price and original price in local currency, discount, rating, review count, units sold, seller, brand, ship-from location, stock flag, sponsored flag, image and product URL. Up to 40 products per page. Unofficial endpoint, may change or rate-limit. Related tools on this server, for a different need: ecommerce_sephora_products when you need Sephora product search from Sephora's own catalog search; ecommerce_openbeautyfacts_products when you need Beauty and personal-care products by brand from Open Beauty. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: sg (default), my, ph, th, vn or id

q.description: Search words, e.g. iphone, air fryer (required, 2-80 chars)
